description.en: polunzh's self-hosted DSH plugin index: Task Notifier, Print Studio, and To-do & Pomodoro. One address to install them from Discover; packages live on npm.
description.zh: polunzh 自建的 DSH 插件索引：任务通知台、打印工坊、待办与番茄钟。加一个地址就能在「发现」里安装，包发在 npm。

description.en: A chime and a system notification the moment a task finishes. The sidebar panel splits needs-input, running and unread-done sessions, and unread state survives a restart.
description.zh: 任务跑完响一声，系统通知同时弹出。侧边栏面板把待回复、运行中、已完成未读分开，未读状态重启后还在。

zh: 任务结束响铃，系统通知和浏览器通知同时到
侧边栏分待回复、运行中、已完成未读
未读状态存本地，重启 DSH 后还在
搜索任务，或一键全部标为已读
窄屏收成单列，手机尺寸也能用
中英双语、深色模式，纯本地不联网
en: A chime plus system and browser notifications when a task finishes
Sidebar panel splits needs-input, running and unread-done
Unread state lives locally and survives a DSH restart
Search tasks, or mark everything read at once
Collapses to one column on narrow screens
Bilingual, dark mode, runs fully offline

screenshots.zh: 三栏任务面板：待回复、运行中、未读
screenshots.en: Three-column panel: needs input, running, unread

screenshots.zh: 只看已完成未读，逐条打开或标记
screenshots.en: Filtered to unread done, opened one by one

description.en: Lay out handouts on a real A4 sheet, with a ribbon for type, leading and columns. Preview pagination before printing, print duplex as the printer allows, and get a receipt.
description.zh: 在 A4 纸面上排讲义，Ribbon 调字体、行距和分栏。打印前全屏预览分页，按打印机能力双面出纸，打完给回执。

zh: 在真实 A4 纸面上排版，所见即所印
Ribbon 工具栏调字体、字号、行距、边距
单栏双栏随时切换
打印前全屏预览分页与纸张校验
按打印机实际支持的能力双面出纸
打完给一张回执，知道哪份已出纸
本地渲染与打印，中英双语
en: Compose on a real A4 sheet, so what you see is what prints
Ribbon toolbar for font, size, leading and margins
Switch between one and two columns
Full-size preview of pagination and paper checks
Duplex printing based on what the printer supports
A receipt after each job tells you what came out
Rendered and printed locally, bilingual

screenshots.zh: 中文界面：Ribbon 在上，A4 纸面在下
screenshots.en: Chinese UI: ribbon above, A4 sheet below

screenshots.zh: 同一份讲义的英文界面

description.en: Todoist-style Today, Upcoming, Inbox and project views, plus a pomodoro bound to tasks. A live countdown in the sidebar, and an agent that reads and writes the same task store.
description.zh: 今天、即将到来、收件箱、项目四种视图管待办，番茄钟绑在任务上。侧边栏秒级倒计时，智能体也读写同一份任务。

zh: 今天、即将到来、收件箱、项目四个视图
截止时间、优先级、标签、子任务、重复规则
日历视图按月看任务，点日期看当天
番茄钟绑任务，专注结束自动累计
侧边栏秒级倒计时，休息标出模式名
输入框下方常驻计时条，不开面板也能控
智能体用 todo 工具读写同一份任务
en: Today, Upcoming, Inbox and project views
Due dates, priorities, labels, subtasks and repeat rules
Calendar view for the month; click a day for its tasks
A pomodoro bound to a task, counted automatically when focus ends
Second-by-second countdown in the sidebar, breaks labelled with their mode
A timer bar under the composer, usable without opening the panel
An agent `todo` tool over the same task store

screenshots.en: Today view: overdue and today apart, with priorities

screenshots.en: Sidebar countdown: breaks labelled and tinted blue
